concerns.text: FR-009 and Plan Phase 1 require computing physical descriptors (volume, atom count, mass) to control for confounding. Task T014a explicitly forbids appending these to `metrics.csv` and T020a restricts VIF to 'network metrics ONLY'. No task exists to include these descriptors in the regression model (T022) or correlation analysis, leaving the confounding control requirement unimplemented.

FR-010 and the 'Small Dataset' edge case require adjusting Bonferroni correction when n < 50. Task T017 and T018a explicitly hardcode alpha to '0.05 / 3' and forbid adjustment based on sample size. No task implements dynamic alpha calculation or power-aware statistical control.

SC-002 requires 'stratified cross-validation' for model performance. Task T023 explicitly implements standard k-fold (not stratified) because the target is continuous. No task exists to implement stratified CV or to reconcile this contradiction with the Success Criterion.

Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires state updates by the Advancement-Evaluator Agent. Task T011, T013, T016, T021, T024 require pipeline scripts to 'immediately' update `state/projects/...yaml` directly. No task exists to implement the Agent-based governance or to delegate state updates to the correct agent, violating the Single Source of Truth governance model.
Task T020c creates `contracts/vif_schema.yaml` but the spec and plan do not define a VIF schema contract. This task references a non-existent requirement/contract ID, creating a stale tag.
